content: Raspberry Pi CM4 has no battery-backed RTC by default (some carrier boards add a PCF85063a); on cold boot the wall clock is unset until NTP sync. Monotonic clock (CLOCK_MONOTONIC / time.monotonic()) is unaffected by wall-clock steps and is the correct source for delta-timestamps and ordering within one boot session, but it is not comparable across two different machines (car Pi vs pit laptop) or across a car reboot. For cross-machine alignment, options are: NTP over the Wi-Fi/Ethernet link when in range (coarse, ms-level, requires network), PPS+GPS (sub-microsecond, requires a GPS receiver), or PTP hardware timestamping (CM4 Ethernet PHY supports IEEE-1588, LAN-only, not applicable over the radio link).
